text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, amidst our ongoing training, I visited Daiichi Ruby's family estate to view the library of the "Illustrious Clan."

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
I wish we could have delivered them to the academy, but...
many of the materials are quite valuable, so they cannot be taken off the premises.
choice_data_list: No, thank you for making the arrangements.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
These are Milady's instructions, after all.
Did you wish to learn about your family's history?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To build a relationship of trust with her,
I thought it was necessary to first understand
what she holds dear.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Milady, you are sorting through the gifts, correct?
I have prepared them in your room.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then, let us head out—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but
please allow me to make a few changes to the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still unable to grasp what was happening, I was brought to a hotel room. After changing into the suit prepared there—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still unable to grasp what was happening, I was brought to a hotel room. After changing into the dress prepared there—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps you'd prefer something a bit more glamorous?
Could you hold up this light blue tie?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps you'd prefer something a bit more glamorous?
Could you hold up this pearl necklace?

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Trainer, please remain just as you are.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
Let us go with this outfit.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I apologize for rushing in like this.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —My mother contacted me to say she is coming to the family home to meet with my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no one in the racing world who does not know her.
A legendary Umamusume who dominated the Tiara route
and left behind truly brilliant achievements—

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—Pleased to meet you, Trainer.
I am Daiichi Ruby's mother.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume standing right in front of me is terribly beautiful, radiating an intense aura. Her appearance and demeanor are just like—
choice_data_list: (It's like Ruby just grew bigger without changing a bit.)

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: I heard you were here at the airport, Trainer. I'm terribly sorry for the sudden intrusion.
choice_data_list: N-No, you must be busy, so...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After retiring from racing, she has been traveling the world
contributing to the development of the Umamusume community.
She has even received several prestigious international awards.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You take such great care of my daughter,
yet I'm only offering my greetings at such a time.
choice_data_list: No, I'm the one who's late...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Facing a big shot I'd only ever seen in the news,
my words got tangled up. Then...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Mother, do you not have plans after this?
Please, tell me what you need.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: Yes, what can I do for you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby's mother fixed her gaze on me.
They were the eyes of one from the “Illustrious Family,”
having appraised thousands of people before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her overwhelming presence made it feel as though she could see right through me, making me want to shrink back, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes, do not forget that image. If you have an ideal to strive for, carry yourself in a manner worthy of it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely what will eventually transform you into the figure you desire to be."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a Trainer worthy of standing alongside her.
If so, I need to hold my head high, just like her...!

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...You are familiar with my running, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of her running,
her hallmark is a breakaway speed that started
with a record-breaking win in her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Mother?
What brings you here...?

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm already done.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ruby, I heard your current schedule is focused
primarily on conditioning your body.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Do you still have concerns?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, it is all to achieve results in the Triple Tiara route.
There is no problem at all.
choice_data_list: (Did she seem a little off just for a second...?)

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so?
I'll leave the decision to you.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Never, ever forget—
what kind of Umamusume I was, you hear?"

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me,
I must head to my next appointment now.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"You wish to peruse our family's book collection?
Please, take all the time you need."

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
please take good care of my daughter.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: "—May you discover her 'greatest radiance.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After Daiichi Ruby's mother left the room,
I looked through various books from the collection and headed back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I learned a great deal from history, but...
the experience that taught me the most about what
it means to be part of the "Illustrious Clan" was, after all—
choice_data_list: Your mother was an amazing person...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Mother is the culmination of our 'Glorious Clan'...
and stands as the symbol of our family today.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That mother... to you...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Regarding my mother's question earlier—
about 'what kind of Umamusume she was.'

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: There was only one answer—she was the most magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you watch footage of her races from her active days,
I'm sure anyone would understand.
It truly deserved to be called brilliance...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a moment, a light seemed to burst in her eyes...
Come to think of it, as soon as she knew she would meet her mother,
she immediately arranged an outfit for herself.
choice_data_list: You really look up to your mother, don't you?
You really look up to your mother, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I respect them as the most brilliant role model
for the path I ought to follow.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Following the great footsteps of my mother... that is what will lead to the future prosperity of our family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why did she desire the Triple Tiara route...
Behind it lay feelings deeper than simply wanting to retrace her family's history.
